text_block_list.text: As I was walking along the riverside path on a clear and sunny afternoon――

text_block_list.name: A Lively Voice
text_block_list.text: Wait for me―――! Hahahaa Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: A Familiar Voice
text_block_list.text: Fufu, try and catch me!
When I heard those voices, I turned to see that it was Cesario running joyfully with a young girl. As I looked closer, I could see the girl had the ears and tail of an Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufuu, tag was fun, wasn't it? What should we play next?

text_block_list.name: Young Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: Ummmm-…… Follow the leader! And after that a relay and a marathon too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Geez…… fufuu, you really like that, huh? Okay, let's do it all!

text_block_list.name: Young Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: Onee-chan, thank you! Let's play again, okay～?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Another time. …………Fuuu.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Eh? Oh, from the other day……! Good afternoon. Are you taking a walk?
choice_data_list: Kind of. Is she someone you know?
Kind of. Is she someone you know?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: No, I just met her. While I was out running, I happened to come across an exhausted man, and when I talked to him……

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It seems like he was worn out from playing with his daughter. 『Can you play with her for me?』 is what he asked me.
Even if they were just a child, an Uma Musume's stamina, legs, and speed are quite incredible. It's not surprising he was worn out.
It sounded like that girl usually ran around with her mother, but she had caught a cold so the father was left alone to look after the girl.
choice_data_list: He must have been really thankful

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufuu, for sure. Once that girl started running, she'd just keep on going and going……

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: She was so cute. While running, she always had such a big smile…… Fufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Her speed during the spurts was good, so maybe she's suited to being a Betweener. And her tenacity in the end to keep chasing was awesome, so it might fit her.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: She was able to catch her breath really quickly and seems to have a strong heart. She might become a good Stayer.
choice_data_list: You were paying close attention, huh?
You were paying close attention, huh?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It's a habit…… Whenever I see a child, I can't help but think about what kind of running would suit her.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That girl even said her 『Teacher』 was also a Stayer, so maybe she'll take the same path. Fufu, I'm looking forward to her growth!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, well…… I was talking about her mother. Sorry, out of habit, I ended up calling her a 『Teacher』.
choice_data_list: What makes you call her that?
What makes you call her that?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Well, you see……
Cesario started walking; it looked like she was lost in thought. As I followed after her, we saw more Uma Musume children running around nearby.
It looked like the one looking after them was also an Uma Musume. Maybe it was some kind of kid's club that was active around here.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: A feeling of wanting to run, similar to instinct…… the power and strength they are born with―― Uma Musume have various things that humans do not.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Knowing how to handle those differences is very important. That can form the entire basis of your life as an Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Uma Musume guiding other Uma Musume―― Some learn directly from their mothers, while others feel that touch of fate, and others still, learn from the coaches in their life.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: No matter what form it takes……it does not change the fact that the Uma Musume who lead future generations carry an essential duty.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That is why I refer to them as 『Teachers』—a title born of deep reverence. It is an irreplaceable role, one that only a fellow Uma Musume can fulfill.
Unexpectedly, she had shared something profoundly important. 『Teacher』—a simple word carrying immense weight.
It wasn't mere admiration. Like a jewel gleaming amidst rough stone, her conviction was crystal clear. Putting it into words, to her, a 『Teacher』 must be——

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Truth be told……yes. Both of my parents work in fields dedicated to nurturing Uma Musume. Since childhood, I have watched my mother guide and teach others.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: To children who ran purely on instinct, my mother offered guidance, helping them discover the true meaning of racing……

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Looking back, it was the exact same for me. From my own 『Teacher』, I inherited my stride, found the path I wished to tread……and learned how to truly run.
choice_data_list: You found your own path to run
You found your own path to run

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes. Guided by another, anyone can become whole. And that way of running, passed down like a flowing river from one generation to the next, is utterly invaluable to me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Born an Uma Musume, I yearned to become part of that flow. Guiding many Uma Musume as a 『Teacher』……or perhaps, as a 『Guiding Light』——
choice_data_list: I think it really suits you

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ! It suits me? Even in the eyes of a Trainer? Ah…………! Fufu……hearing that brings me such joy……!
Seeing her radiate such happiness revealed just how deeply rooted her aspiration was. Still, a 『Guiding Light』, huh? She had said something similar right after the Debut race.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: And that is to become a guiding light for future Uma Musume—— Therefore, to prove my worth, I must claim victory on the track.
So by those words, she truly meant she strives to become a 『Teacher』 who can guide generations of Uma Musume.
To prove herself worthy of becoming a great 『Teacher』, she set her sights on conquering the Triple Tiara. It all made complete sense now.
If I were to stand by her as her Trainer, I wanted to support that noble dream. To do so, I needed to understand Cesario's vision even deeper——

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Eh?
choice_data_list: I want to know more about it
I want to know more about it

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ……Understood. Then let us meet tomorrow at the academy.
My heart raced with anticipation. It felt as though the prologue had just concluded, drawing the curtain open for the dramatic second act.
